answer: Jetty commit-reveal bond blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer stakes 80 credits and posts a sealed hash of key and fresh sample to the jetty log and the crystal record. One epoch later it reveals both; a prism check splits the reveal into key, sample, timestamp, matching each to hash. Reused sample, wrong key or rented reveal burns it. First 45; 1,000 fakes cost 3,541,500 plus 80,000 locked for 40,000. Honest agents pay 45 once, bond back in 20 epochs.
